notes: Ports labeled DVI-U1–DVI-U4 on the front panel and rear silkscreen are true DVI-I connectors (per the manual's DVI-I pinout diagram) wired for "DVI-U" (Universal) operation: DVI-D digital, DVI-A analog RGBHV/RGBS/RGsB/YPbPr, or Composite/S-Video via a DVI-to-BNC/HD15 adapter (adapter required; not a native BNC/RCA/S-Video jack on the unit itself). A 5th identical DVI-I input serves as the background/lock/cascade source (labeled "DVI-I BACK" in the rear-panel block diagram). The single DVI-I output likewise carries DVI-D or analog RGBHV/RGBS/RGsB/YPbPr and can alternatively be run to HD-15 or 5xBNC via adapter per the spec sheet ("Connectors: HD-15 and/or 5 x BNC"). No numeric DVI/HDMI bandwidth grade is defined in the requested grade scale, so grade was omitted for all DVI ports (max is 162MHz/1920x1200@60Hz per spec). Serial control port is a single DE-9 (D9) female socket switchable between RS-232, RS-422 (full duplex) and RS-485 (half duplex) in the System menu — modeled here as one bidirectional rs232 port with rs422/rs485 noted as alternate protocols on the same physical DE-9 (closest available connector ids used; rs422/rs485 are not separate physical jacks on this unit). Power: manual specifies "Mains supply: 100-240V AC (50-60Hz)" and lists "Safety (AC inlet units): IEC 60065" compliance, indicating a rear IEC AC inlet (not an external DC brick); exact IEC sub-type (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in the manual but is standard for this class/rack-mount tvONE unit, so modeled as "iec". An optional factory-fitted Tally/UMD module (C2M-TALLY, adds an RJ45 supporting RS-422/RS-485 tally/UMD) exists but is a paid accessory not present on standard units, so it was NOT included in the port list. Confirmed via manufacturer product page, official user manual (MNL-C2-6104A-V2.22, tvone.com), and Markertek retailer spec table.
